description: The same shape as a document, in a separate collection so previews and in-progress edits are not listed with published content. UNLISTED BY CONVENTION, NOT PRIVATE: an atproto repo is public, so a draft here is readable by anyone who looks. True privacy needs a permissioned space (space-host).

type.description: The content-type key this document instantiates.

publication.description: The site (site.standard.publication) this document belongs to.

bodyBlob.description: When the inline body would be too large for the PDS, the JSON-encoded slice array is uploaded here and `body` is left empty/a stub. Consumers MUST prefer `bodyBlob` when set.

blobs.description: Blob refs living inside bodyBlob; the PDS GC scans only a record's top level, so they must be mirrored here to stay referenced.
